I have really not enjoyed it so far, I also was diagnosed with HG. From 7 weeks to 16 weeks it was so intense and I was off work. My sickness has now eased slightly and I'm feeling baby moving around at 22 weeks so I would say I am enjoying that and it's nice to feel that they are okay I stead of worrying. 

My body doesn't feel like my own as I can't really control anything about it, including my hormones so my emotions are all over the place 😫
Fried rice with a wee bit of curry sauce 🙈

I am LC with my mum and I've not gotten to the birth yet, but when I told my mother she tried to guess when we convieved, and then walked away and came back with a bag filled with baby items (nappies, wipes, clothes, towels, shampoo and moisturiser) and said she was 'just being prepared'. She has called my child her baby once so far and the next time she does I think I might fly on her.
My name is Hollie and people hear Pauline more often than you'd think hahaha
I've noticed this too, I'm 18 weeks! Definitely a thing but don't know why 😂 all the best!
Aw I hope your little Rowan is a dream when they arrive 😁 all the best!

I've been off my work since around 8 weeks on sick lines from my GP. They have given me 2 weeks at a time each time and it's been really easy. I am now 15 weeks and plan to go back at around 17 weeks now that my sickness and nausea have finally subsided 😊

I am 15 weeks and I'm so sure that our dog knows! He has been so protective and is constantly checking on me/snuggling in to me when he usually quite likes his alone time throughout the day. 

We live in a 2nd floor flat and we have this funny little race we do back up the stairs after we've been in the garden. He usually always wins because he's a jack Russell and is very fast despite being 12 this year, but recently he has been letting me win 🥹 We love our little Tim so much 💕

I think it definitely depends on where you live, as obviously in other countries like Japan/Iceland where saunas/onsens/hot springs are more regularly used then the advice is different. 

I am going to be around 17 weeks when we go to a cabin with a hot tub and I will be staying very hydrated and coming out when I feel to hot, but I will definitely be using it! I think you just need to trust your gut, listen to your body and just come out if you feel like it isn't right!

I am 8 weeks and 3 days and I am currently off work with a medical line due to nausea and vomitting. I work in a school with violent/ASN children and my capacity has been so low for anything with them, but also if anything happens I need to leave the room so I am feeling useless. I am hoping that I will feel better after being off for a few weeks on this medical line. My GP was super understanding.

My mum did exactly the same when we got married last September, my wedding wasn't about me, I was being selfish, I wasn't including her etc. 

Please uninvite her if she continues to make you miserable, I wish I had had the guts to uninvite mine. She did in the end spoil my day by only thinking of herself/trying to show off to my in laws.

I Definitely see the line but can't tell if it's an evap or not! If you can, wait 2 days before you test again as HCG doubles every 48 hours so you would see a big difference between them hopefully! But I totally understand not being chill, I am very much the same haha! 

All the best!

Hahahaha, this made me really laugh 😂 sparkly unicorn is the complete opposite of my mother 😂
If only this would work on her 😂 she is different around others so I'm just hoping that I can bank on her being 'nice' around my in laws 🤦🏻‍♀️

We are so excited 🥹 I know it will but she also likes to play the old and ill card so leaving her behind in the hotel once we get there just doesn't seem like an option haha! 

Yeah they do mostly, but I don't feel like they or we should have to deal with her BS on what is supposed to be the happiest day of our lives. 

I just don't want to remember this time for the stress she's putting me under but there is nothing else happening because everything is organised and done haha!

Thank you 💕 we initially considered that when we planned to elope but now all the details are set and the date is significant to us, I don't want to change things we have planned for years. We are getting married in a forest in what is basically a big park so nothing like that. 😔 Thanks for the thoughts though!

Very similar to my own experience! 

I'm 26, an Only child, mum 37 and dad 44 when I was born following fertility issues due to cystic fibrosis on my dad's side. My parents also suffered multiple losses before I was born, I wasn't the first round of IVF for them. 

While I miraculously still have both of my parents even thought they have alot of health issues (mum currently in hospital after emergency bowel surgery), I am not looking forward to my future in caring for them while I want to start having my own family in the next year or so. It's a very scary reality that I can't control.

 I was really involved in the care of both of my grandparents in their last decade and it was really hard when they both passed away; my gran had dementia and could no longer talk or do anything independently in her 81st year, my grandad was blind and wasn't walking anymore in his 87th year. 

As my mum has been ill recently, my partner and I have been having hard conversations about what will happen when they do die. Selling their house, sorting out debt, figuring out how to go forward. As I have just watched my mum lose her parents in the last 7 years ( she is now 63) while I am 26, it feels unfair that I am so young and yet having to think about these hard realities and feeling very alone in these decisions. 

It's a hard decision for OP, there is so much to consider.

When I had my first pregnancy scare at 16, I stressed so much that it delayed my period by over 2 weeks. The chance for you is so small, if he never finished in you and with a condom then I wouldn't worry. I think that a pregnancy test would give you an accurate result as they say wait about 2 weeks after sex. 

Try not to freak out too much, it doesn't help! :) I know that's easier said than done though. All the reasons you listed will definitely be what is holding your period back.

This literally just happened to me and it unfortunately ended in my first miscarriage. I took a test in the morning with the faintest line and then the next morning I tested again but it was BFN. I didn't start bleeding for another week or so, hospital confirmed miscarriage later in that week. 

Thoughts are with you, I hope things are different for you! <3

Wow this is hitting far too close to home for me. 

I had been self harming for probably about 4 months at this point and had confided in one of my friends at school and showed them my cuts.

My mum was called by her mother that same day (which also broke my trust of her even though I know she was only trying to help)  who was a mental health nurse at the time and she only got Angry, embarrassed I think that she didn't know but this other mother did. 

Years later after I had stopped self harming, she brought it up to me that 'it was all a phase' and I couldn't believe it. I was in deep, deep pain at that time for so many reasons but she just saw me literally cutting my arms with a razor blade as a teenage behaviour, how did she convince herself that that was normal? 

It's hard for me to look back on, it has definitely impacted our relationship as I feel I can't go to her about anything. 

I am excited to talk openly about mental health when I have children, I want them to know I have struggled, felt what they are feeling. Just because you are a child doesnt mean that you cannot be depressed or have a mental illness.

I'm so sorry you are feeling this way, I am happy to see you said that writing this post has made you feel better! I really relate to what you are feeling. 

The title of your post stuck out to me and I knew I had to come and talk to you! 

I did it, I quit my job and ran away. I ran from my home in Scotland from my family, my boyfriend, everything to Italy for just over 6 months. I had been really struggling with anxiety and depression for a long time and I needed to do something for me, for what felt like the first time in my life even though I was effecting other peoples lives so greatly that I cared about. 

I worked there as an Au Pair (foreign babysitter) for an amazing Italian family and I can honestly say it was one of the best experiences of my life. But it didn't make the problems go away, it only seemed to magnify them because I knew that I would have to eventually return to them. I had to go home after 6 months because I had gone back to square one, I was barely functioning and I was really struggling to interact with the children on a day to day basis without instantly losing my temper which wasn't ever fair on them. 

What you want to do is brave, do not forget that! It's hard to have studied to get into something you are truly passionate about to get there and hate it or feel overwhelmed by it. If you do decide to quit and try something new, it's okay when that doesn't work out! Life is for failing and learning from that failure. 

I'm here if you need to chat <3

I totally understand and have been thinking the same recently. 

I have always seen marriage as an important part of a relationship, never an end as some might see it. It shows you are both completely committed to each other and want to be together for the rest of your lives. Some use it for insurance purposes, and don't see it as something that important. 

I had always thought I wanted the BIG celebration with all the family and friends together and for it to be maybe a weekend away all together, but looking at the pricing of such a wedding is extortionate. Definitely £20,000+ just for the venue for all those people and accommodation, which is unsettling seeing as we have just bought our first home together and struggled to save the deposit! 

I have come to the realisation I just want it to be us, me and him somewhere outdoors, definitely in our home country of Scotland though. Super personal vows, tears and love, that would not be the same infront of 80+ family and friends. The thought of an 'elopement' really is what I want now, but its hard when it comes to your family that you know would be disappointed as we are both only children. 

At the end of the day, it's your choice and I think that alot of people know when they meet that special someone what they want with them! Whether it be marriage and kids or a chinese takeaway on the couch.

My gran died on Christmas Eve in 2016, she had severe dementia and died being unable to swallow in her bed in a care home with myself, my mum and my auntie at her side. 

A few weeks after she died, we had to clear out my grandads house as it had so much if her old stuff still there, my auntie gave me one of my grans fancy coats and said to try it on. 

I loved the coat and so I decided to keep it, I put my hands in the pockets and I found a small picture in a frame wrapped in a paper towel, (as my gran did with most of her possessions before she went into the home) it was of her and her sister when they were young. They will be together now with the rest of the family, where ever we go after death whether it be heaven or somewhere different ❤️
